newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHALKE V INTER MILAN, UEFA CUP FINAL 1ST LEG TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE V INTER MILAN, UEFA CUP FINAL 1ST LEG TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's UEFA Cup final first leg between Germany's Schalke and Italy's Internazionale Milan:

Schalke - 1-Jens Lehmann, 10-Olaf Thon, 25-Johan de Kock, 2-Thomas Linke, 3-Radoslav Latal, 4-Yves Eigenrauch, 6-Andreas Mueller, 20-Jiri Nemec, 19-Michael Bueskens, 8-Ingo Anderbruegge, 24-Marc Wilmots

Internazionale - 1-Gianluca Pagliuca, 2-Giuseppe Bergomi, 5-Fabio Galante, 19-Massimo Paganin, 3-Alessandro Pistone, 4- Javier Zanetti, 21-Ciriaco Sforza, 7-Salvatore Fresi, 14-Aron Winter, 23-Maurizio Ganz, 9-Ivan Zamorano
